backup.production_rule: restore-proved on 2026-09-08 in a disposable container: 44 public tables, 75 functions, ledger 68/68, zero leftovers. Take a fresh set immediately before the cutover window if this one has aged

forward_verification.name: booking_decision_objects_exist
forward_verification.query: select to_regclass('public.booking_decisions') is not null and to_regclass('public.payment_evidence_candidates') is not null and to_regclass('public.payment_evidence_comparisons') is not null and to_regclass('public.payment_finance_reviews') is not null and to_regclass('public.booking_rate_policy_versions') is not null and to_regclass('public.booking_holds') is not null and to_regclass('public.booking_refund_authorizations') is not null and to_regclass('public.booking_lifecycle_events') is not null

forward_verification.name: module_b_entry_point_was_superseded_not_left_open
forward_verification.query: select to_regprocedure('public.decide_direct_booking_without_finance_review(uuid,text,text)') is not null and not has_function_privilege('anon','public.decide_direct_booking_without_finance_review(uuid,text,text)','execute') and not has_function_privilege('authenticated','public.decide_direct_booking_without_finance_review(uuid,text,text)','execute') and not has_function_privilege('service_role','public.decide_direct_booking_without_finance_review(uuid,text,text)','execute')

forward_verification.name: booking_tables_are_not_anon_readable
forward_verification.query: select not has_table_privilege('anon','public.booking_decisions','select') and not has_table_privilege('anon','public.payment_finance_reviews','select') and not has_table_privilege('anon','public.booking_refund_authorizations','select')

forward_verification.name: refund_and_rate_policy_require_aal2
forward_verification.query: select public.staff_access_allowed('admin','approve_refund',null,'aal2') and not public.staff_access_allowed('admin','approve_refund',null,'aal1') and public.staff_access_allowed('finance','approve_refund',null,'aal2') and not public.staff_access_allowed('cleaner','publish_rate_policy',null,'aal2')

forward_verification.name: one_final_payment_review_per_booking
forward_verification.query: select count(*) = 1 from pg_indexes where schemaname = 'public' and indexname = 'payment_finance_review_one_final_idx'

forward_verification.name: existing_booking_data_survived_the_release
forward_verification.query: select (select count(*) from public.booking_inquiries) >= 0 and (select count(*) from public.calendar_events) >= 0 and (select count(*) from public.airbnb_reservations) >= 0

rollback.safe_until: before any booking decision, payment evidence row, finance review or refund authorization is written; after writes, retain the rows and apply a forward fix or restore the named production set

steps.name: disable_the_reviewed_booking_entry_point
steps.action: revoke EXECUTE on the reviewed decide_direct_booking overload; the live host-confirmed booking path does not call it, so nothing guest-facing changes

steps.name: do_not_rename_the_superseded_function_back
steps.action: decide_direct_booking_without_finance_review is deliberately unreachable and has no grants. Renaming it back would re-open an entry point that can decide a booking without Finance review

steps.name: disable_finance_review_entry_points
steps.action: revoke EXECUTE on public.record_payment_evidence_candidate and public.get_payment_review_queue; leave the tables and their rows in place

steps.name: restore_the_previous_authority_function
steps.action: re-apply the staff_access_allowed body from 20260831010000_privacy_requests_and_holds.sql, which is live as of 2026-09-08. Never drop the function: every operational endpoint reaches it through current_staff_authorized

steps.name: preserve_review_records
steps.action: retain decision, evidence, review, hold and lifecycle rows while the forward fix is prepared; they are the audit trail

feature_flags.name: direct_booking_decision_rpc
feature_flags.required_state: off until a staffed smoke window confirms a decision round-trip and the Finance review queue renders

feature_flags.name: payment_finance_review_ui
feature_flags.required_state: off until the owning product surfaces the queue; the RPCs exist before any UI does

compatibility.evidence: Rehearsed on 2026-09-08 by scripts/recovery/p6/migration-rehearsal-on-host.sh: the 2026-09-08 production set was restored into a disposable, network-internal container on the Docker host, all four migrations applied in timestamp order under ON_ERROR_STOP, and every forward_verification query asserted against the result. This is a contract-phase release because 20260905010000 renames Module B's decide_direct_booking to decide_direct_booking_without_finance_review and revokes every grant on it - a deliberate supersession of an entry point that could decide a booking without Finance review. Nothing outside this batch referenced the old name: it is created by 20260901010000 in the same batch and has never existed in production. The only other replacement is public.staff_access_allowed, whose 20260905030000 body is a strict superset of the live one, adding manage_booking, approve_refund and publish_rate_policy while keeping manage_privacy and every earlier action.

stop_conditions: ORDERING HAZARD - public.staff_access_allowed is redefined by four migrations (20260828000500, 20260831010000, 20260905030000, 20260905040000) and each body is a superset of the one before it. Applying them out of timestamp order silently REMOVES actions. The privacy release went live on 2026-09-08, so this release must come next and the P8 guest-lifecycle release strictly after it
the production restore point is older than the cutover window
any forward verification query returns anything other than its expected value
decide_direct_booking_without_finance_review has any grant after the release - it must be unreachable
